summary.scoring_note: Score uses PASS/(PASS+FAIL); excluded states remain visible and are never silently treated as passes.

results.title: Administrative access requires MFA
results.reason: All observed administrative identities are protected by MFA
results.remediation: Require phishing-resistant MFA for all administrative identities and retest coverage.

results.title: Wildcard administrative grants are prohibited
results.reason: No wildcard administrative grant was detected
results.remediation: Replace wildcard grants with least-privilege actions and scoped resources.

results.title: Control evidence remains within the freshness SLA
results.reason: Evidence is within the configured 30-day freshness SLA
results.remediation: Refresh expired evidence and document an approved exception where automation is unavailable.

results.title: AI systems have an accountable owner
results.reason: At least one AI system lacks an accountable owner
results.remediation: Assign a business owner and technical owner to every in-scope AI system.

results.title: Direct AI interaction disclosure
results.reason: The product exposes the configured AI-interaction disclosure
results.remediation: Add context-appropriate disclosure before or at the first direct AI interaction.

results.title: Synthetic output marking is machine-readable and detectable
results.remediation: Implement interoperable provenance metadata or watermarking and retain detection-test evidence.

results.title: Critical vendors have current assurance evidence
results.reason: At least one critical vendor lacks current assurance evidence
results.remediation: Request current assurance evidence or approve a time-bound risk exception.

results.title: Processor agreement and subprocessor terms require legal review
results.reason: Contract terms, controller/processor roles, transfer mechanisms, and Article 28 sufficiency require qualified legal review.
results.remediation: Review the executed DPA, subprocessor authorization mechanism, transfer basis, and flow-down terms.

results.title: Sensitive prompt egress is blocked or approved
results.reason: No unapproved sensitive-data egress event was observed
results.remediation: Block the destination, rotate exposed secrets where applicable, and route business exceptions for approval.

results.title: Critical findings meet remediation SLA
results.remediation: Escalate overdue critical findings, document the decision, and schedule evidence-backed retesting.

limitations: This reference engine scopes and tests configured controls; it does not issue certification, audit opinions, or legal advice.
Legal applicability and subjective effectiveness judgments are routed to MANUAL_REVIEW.
